intent: Implement the admitted Titanium composition seam for one exact SADHANA campaign JSON projection. The stdlib-only reader and wire validator securely reopen and verify an atomically replaced read model on every explicit-mission request, return only the freshly parsed nested MissionSnapshot, reject stale, foreign, insecure, tampered, self-promotional, or process-lifetime observed rollback, replay, and equivocation state, and deliberately leave generic runtime database projection unavailable.

commit.message: feat(api): add immutable SADHANA campaign reader

interface_mismatches: The supervisor projection is a replaceable derived JSON view, while TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore remain the only canonical state owners.

The existing dashboard treats immutable_copy as permission to query generic runtime databases under the mission-prefixed dashboard session, but campaign owner executions use different exact owner sessions and those reads can initialize or write a database.
A self-digest plus same-UID file custody detects replacement and tamper under the configured account but is not independent authenticity, process liveness, model work, or semantic acceptance.
Projection generation alone is not a per-cycle version; the consumer therefore requires the producer's durable cycle_sequence and rejects backward or same-position contradictory nested snapshots.
A zero-cycle projection is an explicit observation-only wire state; it may be read but cannot satisfy API startup admission until one durable campaign cycle exists.
The full FastAPI lifespan writes operator, trace, and shadow state; only the admitted provider seam is read-only and its first admission must precede those startup writes.
honest_blockers: Repository tests do not prove that a supervisor is deployed, a writer lock is held, a projection remains fresh, a model executes, an output is useful, or an independent verifier accepts it.

The provider intentionally exposes runtime_projection_mode=unavailable; bounded owner-execution projection requires a separate organism-owned contract before the Constellation can show real worker motion.
Same-UID custody and a producer self-digest do not defend against a malicious or compromised process running as the same operating-system account.

The rollback high-water is process-local: after an API restart, a still-fresh older same-generation cycle can be rejected only with an additional trusted startup sequence floor or persisted authoritative anchor; freshness bounds but does not eliminate that replay window.
Startup admission verifies one fresh snapshot, but every request must still re-open and revalidate because the producer atomically replaces the file and may stop, regress, or become stale afterward.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the provider and wire-validation modules, their api/main.py composition, focused tests, and this packet as one unit. Rollback removes only the read-model observer; it does not mutate the supervisor projection, canonical databases, runtime claims, tasks, transports, agents, or external systems.
